title: Exact Conditions: amennyiben and feltéve, hogy

sections.title: Beyond Everyday 'ha'
sections.content: While 'ha' (if) covers general conditional statements in everyday conversation, B2 academic, scientific, and technical prose requires finer tools. 'Amennyiben' (insofar as / provided that / if) introduces an objective prerequisite whose fulfillment determines the main clause. 'Abban az esetben, ha' (in the event that / in the specific case where) narrows the scope to a strictly defined scenario.

sections.title: Stipulating Assumptions with 'feltéve, hogy'
sections.content: 'Feltéve, hogy' (assuming that / on condition that) explicitly flags a working assumption or hypothesis that must hold true for a deduction to remain valid. Like other Hungarian subordinating conjunctions, it is preceded by a comma.

sections.title: Formal Conditional Conjunctions at B2
rows: in the specific case that / in the event that

items.spanish: A feltevés csak akkor igazolódik be, amennyiben a mérések megismételhetők.
items.english: The hypothesis is confirmed only insofar as the measurements are repeatable.

items.spanish: Az eredmény érvényes marad, feltéve, hogy a hőmérséklet nem változik.
items.english: The result remains valid, assuming that the temperature does not change.

items.spanish: Abban az esetben, ha új tünet jelentkezik, azonnal módosítjuk a kezelést.
items.english: In the event that a new symptom appears, we immediately modify the treatment.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Pair 'csak akkor..., amennyiben...' or 'akkor..., feltéve, hogy...' when writing essays to project an authoritative, analytical tone.
